career_ladder.note: Frontline police executive cadre under the Uttar Pradesh Police (Home Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh). exam_scheme.note: Selection comprises an Objective Written Examination of 300 marks (150 MCQs of 2 marks each with 0.5 marks negative penalty), followed by Document Verification & Physical Standard Test (DV/PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET). Merit is drawn strictly from written test scores.

financial_package.note: Constables in Uttar Pradesh Police are placed in Pay Level 3 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,000) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. In addition to basic salary and standard allowances, personnel receive police ration subsidy, kit maintenance, and washing allowance.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 3 & UP Police Departmental Scale
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 with 58% DA (₹12,586), HRA (₹1,200 to ₹3,600 depending on district class), uniform maintenance allowance, diet allowance, net of 10% NPS contribution (₹3,429) and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP Government finance orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district posting (Class X/Y/Z)
Diet Allowance / Ration Subsidy for executive field personnel
Annual Uniform and Kit Maintenance Allowance
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government matching contribution
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
